desc: Implement tree DP with states `dp1[u]` (max size of branch ending at u) and `dp4[u]` (max size of alkane center at u).
For each node, compute `dp1[u]` by taking 1 + max of `dp1[v]` or `dp4[v]` from children.
For each node, compute `dp4[u]` by taking 1 + sum of top 4 values of `max(dp1[v], dp4[v])` from children.
Track the global maximum of `dp4[u]` across all nodes.
If the global maximum is not found (i.e., no node could form a degree-4 center), output -1.
